summary.motive: Use the sprint to displace the entire defense horizontally so the primary corner route or the naked flat checkdown comes open.
summary.whyItWorks: The corner route removes the deep help and the sprint pulls every linebacker away from the line of scrimmage, leaving the flat completely undefended.
summary.failureMode: The flat defender stays home instead of chasing the sprint, closing the checkdown window before the quarterback can set his feet.

beats.title: 1. The Sprint Begins
beats.text: The quarterback takes the snap under center and drives full speed for the right sideline while the line slides with him. The defense's pass rush lanes are instantly misaligned.

beats.title: 2. The Corner Route Climbs
beats.text: Z wins his release and sells pure vertical before snapping to the corner at twelve. The bail corner must turn and run, and the sky safety rotates over the top.

beats.title: 3. The Bracket Forms
beats.text: The corner route is bracketed by the corner and safety — exactly as designed. Both defenders are now staring at Z, and the sprint has dragged every linebacker sideways.

beats.title: 4. The Checkdown Escape
beats.text: With Z consuming two defenders and the linebackers chasing the sprint, the fullback is alone in the flat. The sprinting quarterback sets and delivers the easy completion.

relations.tell: The quarterback leaves the launch point horizontally within half a second — no drop step ever occurs.
